relevance_note: Single case report of a male newborn in whom 'direct sequencing was performed and the diagnosis of ATS was confirmed' after SLC2A10 sequencing; no variant description is printed.
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a short Python script only assembled the JSON and checked spans. One first-hand patient (label 'patient', single unnamed case-report patient). The paper says SLC2A10 exons were sequenced and 'the diagnosis of ATS was confirmed' but prints no variant, zygosity or parental testing, so the variant row has variant_original_string 'not reported' and all variant fields not reported. Parents are described only as 'healthy nonconsanguineous parents', untested; not given rows. A previously published adult patient with CoA and ATS (reference 4) is mentioned in the Discussion with one feature (CoA) and the descriptor 'adult'; included as 'ref 4 patient' under the v4 passing-mention rule (feature given). Ref 4's sex and exact age are not given. Contradiction: TTE describes pulmonary branches 'without stenosis on the trunk or branches', whereas CT describes 'relative elongation and narrowing of the right and left pulmonary arteries' and left pulmonary artery mid-distal narrowing; both phenotypic_features rows emitted and checklist 'pulmonary artery stenosis' set to not reported. The ascending aorta is dilated (Z-score +5.08) but the paper does not say aortic root; checklist 'aortic root aneurysm' left not reported. 'plausible diaphragmatic laxity in the paracaval site' is hedged and not called a hernia; not recorded and checklist diaphragmatic hernia not reported. 'flexed, twisted feet' recorded as stated, not mapped to joint contractures. 'minimal chest excavation' mapped to pectus excavatum (observed). 'bronchial compression and lung collapse' recorded, but respiratory distress not stated (infant was 'in spontaneous breathing' at birth); checklist respiratory distress not reported. Age at death (about 2 months and 15 days) recorded only in deceased_age_iso8601; age at last evaluation left not reported. Age at diagnosis not stated (CTA suspicion at 4 days of life; genetic confirmation date not given). Literature frequencies in the Introduction (e.g. joint laxity 76%) are group-level and not used for any person.
